study_design: Nested case-control study of PSA-detected prostate cancer cases and controls in the ProtecT trial
reason: The abstract reports overall PSA-detected prostate cancer risk. It mentions heterogeneity by stage and grade but does not identify an explicitly advanced or high-grade endpoint or provide the relevant category definitions, so aggressive incidence is not established.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Greater adherence to recommendations to increase plant foods (OR per 0.25 index score increment: 0.94; 95% CI: 0.89-0.99; Ptrend = 0.02) and tomato products (OR adherence vs. nonadherence: 0.82; 95% CI: 0.70-0.97; P = 0.02) was inversely associated with overall prostate cancer risk.
estimate_classifications.reason: The tomato estimate is explicitly for overall prostate cancer risk, not an aggressive subtype.
